title: 2024 HMMT November Guts Problem 6
statement: The vertices of a cube are labeled with the integers 1 through 8, with each used exactly once. Let \(s\) be the maximum sum of the labels of two edge-adjacent vertices. Compute the minimum possible value of \(s\) over all such labelings.
